exam.exam_name: Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission State Service Examination (CGPSC SSE)

source_evidence.captured_wording: Candidate must upload recent photograph of file size between 20 KB and 100 KB and signature of file size between 10 KB and 50 KB in JPG/JPEG format.

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
dimensions.permitted_pixel_range: 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm standard passport size; 20 KB to 100 KB

spectacles.source_wording: Clear glasses allowed; no tinted glasses or glare

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm standard passport size; 20 KB to 100 KB; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; Light or White background; File size between 20 KB and 100 KB verified at upload
JPG, JPEG; 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm standard; 10 KB to 50 KB; 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm; Plain white background; Signature in running hand; capital letters rejected; File size 10 KB to 50 KB enforced

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: State Service Examination 2023 Detailed Advertisement - General Instructions, Para 7 (https://psc.cg.gov.in)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: State Service Examination 2023 Detailed Advertisement - General Instructions, Para 7 (https://psc.cg.gov.in)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
